images.title: File:Wieliczka Salt Mine (35322151183).jpg
images.description:
Opened in the 13th century, the Wieliczka Salt Mine is one of the world's oldest and produced table salt continuously until 2007. 

The mine is currently one of Poland's official national Historic Monuments. Its attractions include dozens of statues and four chapels carved out of the rock salt by the miners.
